title: Stop Saying "Very Easy"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very easy". Use one of these words instead:
• Simple: a simple puzzle
• Effortless: an effortless win
• Straightforward: straightforward instructions
• Painless: a painless way to learn
• Foolproof: a foolproof recipe
